walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of Europe — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of Europe brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of Europe.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which Bolshevik slogan summarised Lenin's April Theses?
options: Peace, Land, Bread
Workers of the world unite
Liberte, egalite, fraternite
Better dead than red

mcqs.q: What was the immediate cause of the February Revolution?
options: German invasion
Bread shortages in Petrograd
Lenin's return from Switzerland
Kerensky's offensive

mcqs.q: Why was the NHS founded in 1948?
options: The peasants wanted to make Wat Tyler king of England.
Beveridge's 1942 report identified disease as a 'giant evil'; Labour's 1945 manifesto promised universal healthcare; Bevan unified hospitals and made care free at point of use.
The NHS was founded because Churchill wanted to thank soldiers after WWII.
The NHS was founded in 1918 after the influenza pandemic.

mcqs.q: What caused the Peasants' Revolt of 1381?
options: The poll tax of 1381 on top of long-term anger over labour laws restricting peasant wages after the Black Death and resentment at clerical wealth.
The peasants wanted to make Wat Tyler king of England.
The NHS was founded in 1918 after the influenza pandemic.
The peasants revolted because they were starving and had no food.
